description: As a 29-year daily Muni rider — and frequent BART rider as well — Scott secured billions in state funding to keep Bay Area transit running and authored laws to fast-track clean energy projects. Scott is California’s leading advocate for affordable and reliable transportation and in Congress, he’ll fight to expand federal funding for transit and cut red tape to deliver projects faster and at lower costs.

title: Scott Wiener for Congress: Transportation
